policies.title: Kazakhstan ordinary passport: Turkmenistan visa required
policies.summary: Kazakhstan MFA’s current passport-type table marks Turkmenistan as “visa” for an ordinary Kazakhstan passport, consistent with Turkmenistan’s statutory foreign-visitor visa baseline.
conditions: This normalization does not cover work, transit, diplomatic/service passports, residence-based entry or any local border arrangement.
Visa issuance and final admission remain subject to the competent Turkmen authorities and required documents.

policies.title: Russian ordinary passport: Turkmenistan visa required
policies.summary: Russia MFA’s current passport-type table records that a Russian ordinary passport requires a visa for Turkmenistan; the cited bilateral agreement is limited to the listed visa-free passport class.
conditions: This maps only ordinary passports for a short visitor purpose. It excludes diplomatic/service passports, residence/document exemptions, work, transit and individual admission decisions.

Turkmenistan’s current law provides that visa/eVisa is unnecessary where its international treaties provide a waiver; the Russian MFA table identifies the ordinary Russian passport as requiring a visa.
Visa issuance and final admission remain subject to the competent Turkmen authorities and required documents.
